For domain files the rubric forbids persistence and I/O, and it excuses injected repositories only in application files. OrderService keeps infrastructure gateways from src/persistence (OrderGateway, ProductGateway, CustomerGateway) as fields. It runs persistence reads and writes itself: findById, findBySku, updateStock and save. It also does record mapping (toOrderRecord, toOrder and others). This is persistence work running inside a domain file. There are no HTTP or framework types, decorators or base classes. The other types it uses (BusinessError, Money, Order, OrderLine, PricingPolicy) are the project's own. Confidence is moderate because the class is written as a service layer, which some designs treat as application code.
